6730.title: Codex Computer Use lifecycle: native termination remains unverified
6730.rootCauseOneLine: Not established. Trusted bridge cancellation, interrupt/release, and child shutdown checks pass; the native macOS Computer Use session was not available to observe.
6730.proposedFix: On an isolated macOS host, capture a failing provider thread/turn, exact termination action, native cua_repl activity and control ownership before and after normal completion, Stop, and archive separately. Correlate the native interrupt/completion replies and app-server exit; distinguish a live Computer Use session from reusable idle processes before changing cleanup.
6730.caveats: Linux fixture-level negative reproduction only; no native macOS Computer Use session. Both clean runs pass 45 baseline / 47 probed tests; native termination remains unverified.
